## [2026-07-25] session | MILOS — /app/orientation redesigned: carousel of 7 Maqāsid cards + bottom sheet

The operator asked to reskin the shipped `/app/orientation` surface ([[2026-07-23-milos-orientation-screen]]) into a prototype's visual language — a **carousel of 7 Maqāsid domain cards** (weakest centred + flagged, the rest one swipe away) with all depth moved into a **bottom sheet** — after user testing found the ladder + balance-strip layout hard to act on. Exploration confirmed the recommendation **engine already shipped**, so this was a **UI reskin over a proven engine**, not a rebuild. Four decisions locked with the operator via AskUserQuestion: redesign **in place** (reuse engine); **defer** the streak counter + "welcome back" banner (conflicts with the locked no-streak/guilt decision); **extend the engine** for priority-aware task selection; **mobile-first** centred 520px column (defer desktop). Scope boundary held: only the standalone route — `Dashboard.jsx`/`/app` home untouched, orientation not made the home. Full detail: [[2026-07-25-milos-orientation-carousel-redesign]].

**Amanah gate:** neutral-to-positive. Presentational/navigational only — no seed `sources[]`/`description`, fiqh, or capital surface touched; no CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share. It surfaces existing graded evidence (Qur'an/hadith with grading visible in the sheet's Evidence accordion) and authors no new fiqh. The redesign preserves the Islamic framing — bilingual pillar headers (Arabic preservation-phrases حفظ الدين … حفظ الأمة), the tier-gate that puts Necessities first, and the three non-punitive exits.

- **Engine extension ([orientation-selector.js](src/data/orientation-selector.js)).** `PRIORITY_RANK = {urgent:0,high:1,medium:2,low:3}`; `findFirstEligibleInPillarTier` now sorts a pillar+tier's tasks by priority **then** authored `order` (was `order` only). New `buildOrientationCarousel({projects,tasksByProject,todayKey}) → {cards, recommendedPillarId}` returns the seven `MAQASID_CORE_PILLARS` in canonical order, `recommendedPillarId` derived from `recommendOrientation(...)` so the flagged card is exactly what the engine surfaces (inherits tier fall-through).
- **Components.** Retired `OrientationLadder` + `OrientationBalanceStrip`. New `OrientationCarousel.jsx` (scroll-snap track + dot row), `OrientationCard.jsx` (one `<button>`: Arabic+English name, crumb, priority pill, "Now" line, progress bar, recommended + caught-up variants), `OrientationSheet.jsx` (bottom sheet on the **shared** `pp-slideup__*` chrome + `useFocusTrap` — portal/`role=dialog`/`aria-modal`/Escape; Why&how + Evidence accordions; three-action footer). Reused `OrientationEvidence.jsx` unchanged; `OrientationActions.jsx` trimmed 4→3 (dropped "Something else" — **the carousel is the pillar picker**).
- **Container ([Orientation.jsx](src/components/orientation/Orientation.jsx)).** Effect-driven recompute preserved; held-task continuity is now sheet-level via `openPillarId` + `pendingRef`; `dayKeyRef` keeps the wall-clock read out of render (this **also cleared** the pre-existing `Date.now()` purity lint error the prior ADR left red). No more `tick`/`overrideRef`.
- **The tier gate proved live.** With all seven pillars seeded, **Health** (0/96 — the weakest active-tier ratio) was flagged "Weakest — recommended," chosen over Faith (1/139) by *ratio*. Its leading task happens to be *urgent* and Intellect's *high*, so the pillar was picked by tier-gate weakness while priority only ordered the task **within** Health — recommendation follows tier-gate weakness, not task priority. Exactly as designed.
- **Verified.** `npm run build` ✓; `npm test` **102/102** (new priority-order + carousel coverage); `npm run lint` **green across all three gates** (eslint 0, grounding-strict pass, inline-refs 0 — no seed edits). **The screenshot tool worked this session** (contrast the recurring [[project-screenshot-hang]] that blocked the prior orientation ADR): captured the carousel **light** (Health flagged, 7 dots), the open **Health sheet** (URGENT/Bayyinah/Grounded tags, Now box, 3 actions), and the carousel **dark** (all colours flip through tokens, no light-mode bleed). DOM/behavior corroborated: canonical order, sheet focus-trap + Escape, Mark-done recompute + continuity (`0/3 → 1/3`), evidence lazy-load, **0 console errors**. All seven pillars were seeded in the **isolated preview browser** via the app's own `ensure*Projects` (navigating each `-core` route) — preview-only state, not the operator's data.
- **Spotted in passing (out of scope, flagged).** Verifying the Health pillar exposed pre-existing UTF-8/cp1252 **mojibake** — corrupted `→`/apostrophes/dashes — **485 occurrences across 3 files** (`health-seed-tasks.js` 388, `health-readiness-ayat.js` 87 ⚠️ Qur'an data, `niyyah-feelings.js` 10). It predates this work; the plan excluded seed edits. Flagged as background task `task_2e56b6bf` with a covenant-aware fix brief (restore from git history, human review on the ayat file) and tracked at [[project-seed-mojibake]].
- **Deferred:** committing (operator-gated — uncommitted on `feat/desktop-pillar-glyphs`); the seed mojibake sweep (`task_2e56b6bf`, recommended as the next session); streak/"welcome back" gap-detection; a genuine desktop layout; weighted weakness formula; relocating `SubtaskSources` to `shared/`.
- **Decisions:** [[2026-07-25-milos-orientation-carousel-redesign]] (new); [[2026-07-23-milos-orientation-screen]] (amended — its ladder+strip UI marked partially superseded, engine/tier-gate/snooze retained).
- **Pages touched:** wiki/decisions/2026-07-25-milos-orientation-carousel-redesign.md (new), wiki/entities/project-seed-mojibake.md (new), wiki/decisions/2026-07-23-milos-orientation-screen.md (amended), wiki/entities/milos.md, wiki/index.md, wiki/log.md. **Source (uncommitted on `feat/desktop-pillar-glyphs`):** modified src/data/orientation-selector.js + src/data/__tests__/orientation-selector.test.js; rewrote src/components/orientation/Orientation.jsx + Orientation.css + OrientationActions.jsx + CONTEXT.md; created OrientationCarousel.jsx, OrientationCard.jsx, OrientationSheet.jsx, OrientationSheet.css; retired OrientationLadder/OrientationBalanceStrip.

## [2026-07-25] session | MILOS — every prayer node's During tab now has a "how to pray" guide (Dhuhr/Asr/Maghrib/Tahajjud)

Third same-day prayer-popup session, and the one that completes the During tab. Having inlined `PrayerHeroDuring` into the During tab ([[2026-07-25-milos-prayer-popup-consolidation]]), the popup still showed a **coming-soon shell** on four of the six prayer nodes — only Isha and Fajr had a guide. Operator: *"Every prayer node in the prophetic path is missing the how-to in the during tab except for Isha. Let's fix that."* The premise was slightly off (Fajr already had one — masked by the shell's stale *"Isha is available today"* copy), so the real gap was **four prayers: Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Tahajjud**. Chosen with the operator via AskUserQuestion: scope **all four**, approach **shared builder**, grounding **yes — author matching corpora**. Full detail: [[2026-07-25-milos-prayer-during-guides-all-nodes]].

**Amanah gate:** positive. Every recitation is copied **verbatim** from the already-verified [isha-during.js](src/data/isha-during.js); every citation is reused from `nb_salah_isha.json` or the already-graded `PRAYER_GUIDE.sources[]`. **No hadith number and no Arabic was invented.** The one new fiqh-adjacent surface — Tahajjud's non-"Fard" framing + its pairs-of-two/Witr closing note — is drawn verbatim from `PRAYER_GUIDE`. No capital/CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share surface.

- **Shared builder, verified files untouched.** New [prayer-during-builder.js](src/data/prayer-during-builder.js) holds the recitation objects copied verbatim from `isha-during.js`; `buildPrayerSequence({ rakahCount, audibleRakahs, closingNote })` encodes the standard sequence (first tashahhud iff `rakahCount ≥ 3`; final tashahhud + ṣalawāt + salām; `audibleRakahs` flips aloud/silent notes) and **computes** `posturesPerRakah` rather than hand-typing it. Four ~6-line files consume it: [dhuhr-during.js](src/data/dhuhr-during.js)/[asr-during.js](src/data/asr-during.js) (4 rakʿāt, silent), [maghrib-during.js](src/data/maghrib-during.js) (3 rakʿāt, aloud r1–2), [tahajjud-during.js](src/data/tahajjud-during.js) (2-rakʿāt nafl unit + closing note). The working Isha/Fajr files were left alone (zero regression surface). Structures confirmed against `PRAYER_GUIDE` — nothing invented.
- **The Tahajjud "Fard" guard.** The Reference header hardcodes *"How to pray {label} **Fard**"* — a fiqh error for a voluntary prayer. Added an optional `headline` override in [prayer-sequences.js](src/data/prayer-sequences.js); Tahajjud renders **"How to pray Tahajjud — 2 rakʿāt at a time"**, the four fard prayers keep the default wording. [PrayerHeroDuring.jsx](src/components/islamic/PrayerHeroDuring.jsx) also had the stale "Isha is available today" line dropped from the (now-unreachable) coming-soon shell.
- **Grounding corpora (provenance-only).** `nb_salah_{dhuhr,asr,maghrib,tahajjud}.json` at repo root reuse Isha's 12 recitation entries byte-identical; only the prayer-specific `topic`/`description`/`structural_notes` differ, each citing in-repo sources (Tahajjud: Bukhari 990 / Muslim 749, Bukhari 1147 / Muslim 738, Muslim 752). Not imported/rendered/test-gated — matching how isha/fajr corpora already behave — so the `-during.js` "Grounded in…" pointers aren't false.
- **Verified.** `npm test` **94/94**; `npm run build` **✓ 1.33s** (all new imports resolve). The three CLAUDE.md-documented lint gates green: `lint:eslint` **0 errors**, `lint:grounding-strict` **[STRICT] Pass** (prayer 87/87 grounded, 0 legacy), `audit:inline-refs` **[STRICT] OK** (prayer 0). The composite `npm run lint` exits red **only** on its 4th step, the branch-local WIP `generate:pillar-glyphs:check`, which timed out SSR-loading a **health-pillar** file ([HealthLevelNavigator-constants.js](src/pages/health/HealthLevelNavigator-constants.js)) — structurally impossible to be my prayer change, the same nondeterministic Vite-transport timeout proven not-mine last session (it hit the *Family* navigator then, *Health* now). **The screenshot tool was unavailable** ([[project-screenshot-hang]] — pane not displayed, synthetic clicks not delivered), so verification was **DOM-level** and said so: all four guides render with During as the active tab, zero mojibake, correct rakʿah sections; the **critical check passed** — Tahajjud's header carries **no "Fard"** (`headerSaysFard: false`), its closing note + Pray-Along first step render intact.

## [2026-07-25] session | MILOS — non-prayer node popup: tasks moved onto During, Before/After reduced to ceremony previews

Same-day complement to the prayer-popup entry below. Having reshaped the six *prayer* nodes' popup, the operator turned to the *non-prayer* nodes with one instruction — *"Move the task list from before and after to the during tab."* Two constraints confirmed by follow-up: **scope is non-prayer nodes only** (prayer nodes keep the layout from [[2026-07-25-milos-prayer-popup-consolidation]]), and **Before/After keep their `CeremonySummary` ceremony preview** — only the task list leaves them. A third case surfaced mid-work and was resolved by the operator: `midday-labor`, the one non-prayer node whose During showed a `showProjects` Projects/Education view instead of a task list, should **show the task list** like its peers. Full detail: [[2026-07-25-milos-nonprayer-tasks-to-during]].

**Amanah gate:** neutral. Presentational/navigational only — no seed data, grounding `sources[]`, fiqh, or capital surface touched. No CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share. Before/After stay the threshold-ceremony (du'ā) affordances; only the task list changed tabs.

- **The core change is one filter drop.** Non-prayer nodes previously split their task pool across three tabs by keyword `phaseMatchers` (Before caught `/plan|planning|prep/`, After `/wrap|close/`, During the `main` remainder) — which is *why* the operator's "Plan the week's deep-work" task sat under **Before**, not During. In [NodePhaseSlideUp.jsx](src/components/islamic/NodePhaseSlideUp.jsx) the `phaseTasks` non-prayer branch now calls `buildTasksForNode(node.id, …, { phase: null, limit: 20, … })` — `phase: null` skips the split so During shows the *combined* Before+main+After pool; `limit` raised 8 → 20 so the merged set isn't truncated. `SLOT_BY_PHASE` and the `slot` local were removed (dead after the drop).
- **Before/After = `CeremonySummary` alone.** The `<div className="pp-phase-tasks">{taskList}</div>` wrapper was removed from the non-prayer branch, and its now-orphaned `.pp-phase-tasks` rule deleted from [NodePhaseSlideUp.css](src/components/islamic/NodePhaseSlideUp.css) (grepped to zero references first).
- **`showProjects` plumbing removed.** The `showProjects`/`scopeProjects` `useMemo` and its now-unused imports (`buildUserProjectsForScope`, `submodulesForNode`, `getPillarSubmoduleIds`) were dropped from `NodePhaseSlideUp.jsx`; the During call passes `showProjects={false}`. `midday-labor`'s During now renders the task list under the same Wealth/Community + Action/Education toggles as every other non-prayer node. `MirrorCard`'s `showProjects` branch is left intact in [PropheticPathMirror.jsx](src/components/islamic/PropheticPathMirror.jsx) — a reusable export, simply never reached now.
- **Verified (DOM-level).** The **screenshot tool was unresponsive this session** (*"Browser pane is not displayed, so the page is not compositing frames"* — the recurring [[project-screenshot-hang]] failure, in contrast to the working run recorded in the entry below). Via DOM inspection at `/app/prophetic-path`: **Midday Labor** During → 20-card task list, no `.pp-project-list`, both weekly-planning tasks present, toggles intact; Before → `.pp-ceremony` "Begin opening", 0 task lists; After → `.pp-ceremony` "Begin closing", 0 task lists. **Fajr** (prayer regression) → During still the inline `phd-root` guide, Before still the bare task-list branch. `npm test` **94/94**; ESLint on `NodePhaseSlideUp.jsx` **0 problems**; `npm run build` **✓ clean**. Full composite `npm run lint` **still red only** on the same pre-existing unrelated `Date.now()` purity error in [Orientation.jsx:42](src/components/orientation/Orientation.jsx) ([[2026-07-23-milos-orientation-screen]]) — surfaced, not hidden.
- **Deferred:** committing (operator-gated — uncommitted on `feat/desktop-pillar-glyphs`); the pre-existing `Orientation.jsx:42` lint error still blocks the green composite gate and belongs to the orientation feature, not this work.
- **Decisions:** [[2026-07-25-milos-nonprayer-tasks-to-during]] (new); [[2026-07-25-milos-prayer-popup-consolidation]] (amended in place — its "non-prayer untouched" carve-out reversed).

## [2026-07-25] session | MILOS — prayer node popup consolidated: tasks-only Before/After, the prayer guide inlined into During

The operator gave two corrections across two turns on the six prayer nodes' popup (`NodePhaseSlideUp`, Before/During/After tabs): *"In the popup for the prophetic path for prayers, I only want to see the list of tasks and not the list of prayers"* and, next turn, *"the during tab should contain the content it currently refers/links to."* The first removes the `PrayerSunnahSummary` rawātib card added two days earlier ([[2026-07-23-milos-prayer-node-sunnah-tabs]]); the second replaces the During tab's *"Open prayer phases"* hand-off button with the actual during-the-prayer guide rendered inline. When the now-orphaned hand-off destination came up, the operator said *"Delete it."* Full detail: [[2026-07-25-milos-prayer-popup-consolidation]].

**Amanah gate:** neutral-to-positive. No capital instrument, no CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share surface. **Authors no fiqh and deletes none** — the graded `PRAYER_GUIDE` data stays in the repo, still seeds the anatomy boards, and remains reachable on the `/faith-salah` route. The popup does not genericize the covenant framing: it *deepens* the During tab (full rakʿah-by-rakʿah guide inline, richer than the button it replaced) and declutters Before/After to the actionable task list the operator asked for.

- **Two small render changes, in [NodePhaseSlideUp.jsx](src/components/islamic/NodePhaseSlideUp.jsx).** During on a prayer node: `body = <PrayerHeroDuring pillarKey={node.id} />` (non-prayer keeps `MirrorCard`). Before/After on a prayer node: `body = taskList` — the bare list, deliberately **without** the `.pp-phase-tasks` wrapper, whose separator `border-top` would strand at the top of the already-padded body; the tab label carries the phase context that `PrayerSunnahSummary`'s header used to. Non-prayer nodes keep `CeremonySummary` + the task divider, fully untouched. `PrayerHeroDuring` positions relatively (no viewport-fixed layout), so it — and Pray-Along's swipeable cards — render inside the popup's `overflow: auto` body without breakage.
- **The deletion cascade, grepped before each removal.** Removing the hand-off orphaned `PrayerSlideUp`; `PrayerSlideUp` was the only importer of the cloned `PrayerLevelPage`; `PrayerLevelPage` was the only importer of the cloned `PrayerLevelNavigator`; and change #1 orphaned `PrayerSunnahSummary`. **Six files deleted** (`PrayerSlideUp.jsx`+CSS, `PrayerLevelPage.jsx`, `PrayerLevelNavigator.jsx`, `PrayerSunnahSummary.jsx`+CSS). **Kept:** `PrayerHeroDuring` (now consumed *only* by the popup), `ProjectBoard`, `LevelNavigator`, shared `PillarLevelPage.css`.
- **Retained-but-unrendered, named as debt.** `PRAYER_GUIDE` and its `getPrayerPhaseSunnah` / `SUNNAH_LEAD` selector in [prayer-seed-tasks.js](src/data/seed-tasks/prayer-seed-tasks.js) lost their only render consumer (`PrayerSunnahSummary`) but stay — they still seed the `prayer_{id}_during` anatomy boards, and the graded data is worth keeping against a future Sunnah surface. Dead in the render path, alive as the read model. Prunable later if no such surface returns.
- **Supersession handled in place, not by deletion.** [[2026-07-23-milos-prayer-node-sunnah-tabs]] marked `status: superseded` + `superseded_by` with a `[!warning]` callout — its *display* is reversed, its fiqh reasoning stands as record. [[2026-04-21-prayer-slide-up-fln]] carries a **partial-supersede** callout: its clone-don't-parameterize decision (#1) is undone and its During-hero (#5) relocates into the popup, but its 18 boards (#2), Option-A seed duplication (#3), and non-destructive migration (#4) survive — the boards are still read by `buildPrayerPhaseTasks` ([[2026-07-23-milos-prayer-phase-task-boards]]).
- **Verified:** `npm test` **94/94**; ESLint on the four edited source files **0 errors**; `npm run build` **✓** with no dangling imports from the six deletions. The full composite `npm run lint` stays red **only** on a pre-existing, unrelated error — `Date.now()` purity in [Orientation.jsx:42](src/components/orientation/Orientation.jsx), the in-progress orientation screen staged on this branch and not touched here — so the covering gates (edited-file ESLint, `npm test`, `npm run build`) were run separately to show green rather than hide behind the red aggregate.
- **The screenshot tool worked this session** — a genuine contrast with the three prior runs ([[project-screenshot-hang]]). On a fresh guest profile at `/app/prophetic-path`: **Fajr** Before → task list only (no rawātib card), During → the inline `PrayerHeroDuring` guide with **Begin Pray-Along** rendering the swipeable posture cards *inside* the panel (working Switch-to-Reference / Exit / Prev-Next), After → task list only; **Dhuhr** During → `PrayerHeroDuring`'s own coming-soon card; **Midday Labor** (non-prayer) → During still `MirrorCard`, Before still `CeremonySummary` — the non-regression check. Closing the popup mid-Pray-Along was clean (no Escape double-fire between PrayAlong's exit and the popup's focus-trap `onClose`).
- **Deferred:** committing (operator-gated — uncommitted on `feat/desktop-pillar-glyphs`); pruning `getPrayerPhaseSunnah`/`SUNNAH_LEAD` if no Sunnah surface returns; and still outstanding from prior sessions — the `--text1` sweep, the `isPrayerLocked` → `prayerBannerActive` rename, `SCHEMA.md`'s stale "append to log" wording (this file is **prepended**), and the missing [[project-screenshot-hang]] page.

## [2026-07-23] session | MILOS — new `/app/orientation` screen: one ranked subtask instead of a 1,900-item backlog

Built from an operator-shared concept mockup (`maqasid-orientation-v2.html`) across four approved phases: data/selector layer, components, routing/wiring, verification. Three binding decisions locked in before scoping — standalone route (not folded into `NiyyahAct` or the Dashboard), ranking that respects necessity tier system-wide (Daruriyyat/Hajiyat/Tahsiniyat, never blended — a pillar done with its obligations must never rank behind one merely incomplete on nice-to-haves), and a real "Not today" snooze (excludes the subtask until the next Islamic day) rather than the mockup's cosmetic version. Full detail: [[2026-07-23-milos-orientation-screen]].

**Amanah gate:** neutral-to-positive. Presentational/navigational only — no capital instrument, no CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share surface. Surfaces existing graded Qur'an/hadith evidence via the pre-existing `SubtaskSources` component; authors no new fiqh claims.

- **Reuse over invention.** Pillar/tier data, tier resolution (`getProjectLevel`), and evidence rendering all already existed — the new surface area is one selector module (`orientation-selector.js`) plus two runtime-only subtask fields (`notApplicable`, `snoozedUntilDayKey`), confirmed pre-build and re-confirmed post-build not to intersect the grounding lint/test ratchets (those read only static seed `sources[]`, never runtime store state).
- **Two state-design calls worth remembering.** (1) Recommendation recompute is effect-driven (`useEffect` on `[projects, tasksByProject, todayKey, tick]`), not imperative per-action derivation — this is what let a transient async-preload race resolve itself with no extra plumbing (below). (2) The "Something else" pillar override is a one-shot ref (`overrideRef`), consumed and cleared by the very effect run it triggers; if the overridden pillar has nothing eligible, the selector falls through to the normal top pick and suppresses the "Set aside" ack rather than showing a misleading one.
- **Investigated, not fixed — a transient empty-state race.** Early in verification, `/app/orientation` briefly showed "You're all caught up" while the Faith pillar's own pages showed real incomplete projects. Root cause: `tasksByProject` starts `{}` and is populated only by async `loadTasks(projectId)`; `AppShell.jsx` eagerly calls `loadTasks` for every project on mount, and the read landed inside the brief window before that preload resolved. No code change — the effect-driven recompute above means Orientation self-corrects once the preload finishes, confirmed by re-navigating and observing the correct Faith → Necessities → Hajj recommendation with real evidence.
- **Seed-data note, not a bug:** this guest account only has real seeded task content for the Faith pillar (`bbiz_tasks_faith_*`); the other 6 pillars have zero seeded task keys, so their balance-strip tier badges trivially read "Excellence" (0/0 vacuously satisfied). Confirmed by direct `localStorage` inspection.
- **Verified:** `npm test` 94/94 (new `orientation-selector.test.js` suite included); `npm run lint:eslint` 0 errors (full composite `lint` skipped — pre-existing unrelated `generate:pillar-glyphs:check` SSR timeout, not caused by this work); `npm run build` green. **The screenshot tool did not work** — `computer({action:"screenshot"})` failed twice with the same recurring *"Browser pane is not displayed, so the page is not compositing frames"* error seen in multiple prior sessions this month ([[project-screenshot-hang]]-class) — disclosed rather than assumed; substituted `get_page_text`/`read_page`/`computer`-click DOM verification, which confirmed all four actions (Mark done, Doesn't apply, Not today, Something else) work correctly against real store data, including held-task continuity and the graceful set-aside fallback above.
- **Deferred:** pixel-level screenshot proof (environment limitation, not scoped work); this feature's changes are uncommitted on `feat/desktop-pillar-glyphs`, commit is operator-gated.
- Decisions: [[2026-07-23-milos-orientation-screen]]
- Pages touched: `wiki/decisions/2026-07-23-milos-orientation-screen.md` (new), `wiki/entities/milos.md`, `wiki/index.md`, `wiki/log.md`

## [2026-07-23] session | MILOS — the prayer boards the popup could not see, and Tahajjud's Before offering the night prayer as its own approach

Same-day follow-on to the two entries below. The operator opened Tahajjud in the new popup and returned one sentence — *"there's so much more to the before of Tahajjud that's missing from here"* — attached to a screen showing a single `Qiyām · Pairs of 2` card above the line **"No tasks queued for this window."** Both halves of that screen were wrong, **for two entirely unrelated reasons**. Investigated and presented first, per the operator's standing *"Identify and present before updating"*; edits began only after they chose.

**Amanah gate:** positive. No capital instrument, no CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share surface. The change restores hadith-graded practice the app had **seeded and then hidden from its own user**, and removes a chip that would have called a *muʾakkadah* Sunnah an embellishment. As with the sessions below, it **authors no fiqh** — every string surfaced already existed in `PRAYER_GUIDE`, already graded.

- **Committed first, as asked.** `c8e4d60` carried the whole prior session (popup + per-prayer Sunnah), closing the "Deferred: committing" item recorded in the entry below. The fix that followed is `4ec016e` (6 files, +154/−12). Neither is pushed. Explicit pathspecs throughout — `atlas`, `.claude/worktrees/*` and the two protected wiki pages were never staged.
- **Defect 1 — the tasks were unreachable, not missing.** A seeded 4-subtask task, *"Rise for Tahajjud with the prophetic waking protocol"* (wipe sleep from the face with Āl-ʿImrān 3:190–200, the waking duʿāʾ of tawḥīd/ḥamd/istighfār, siwāk, istiftāḥ), was sitting on the `prayer_tahajjud_before` board the entire time. **`PRAYER_BOARDS` generates all 18 boards (6 prayers × 3 windows) with `moduleId: null`**, and `buildTasksForNode` filters projects through `MODULE_ID_TO_SUBMODULE_ID[p.moduleId]`, keeping only those that resolve to a canonical submodule. `null` in, guard fails, board dropped. Proven against the live store: **18/18 boards null, 49 seeded tasks hidden** — every prayer, every tab, since the popup shipped the day before. Tahajjud's Before was simply the window where the absence was loud enough to notice.
- **The fix reads the board, not the inference.** For a prayer node the board *is* the phase, so `buildPrayerPhaseTasks` resolves `prayer_{id}_{phase}` by id. It keys on `phase`, **not** `slot` — `SLOT_BY_PHASE` translates `during → main` for the legacy vocabulary and would silently miss every During board. Two tempting alternatives were rejected with reasons on record: setting `moduleId: 'faith-salah'` at source needs a **storage migration** (the nulls are already persisted under the `bbiz_` prefix) *and* would leak all 18 boards into every other faith-salah surface; resolving prayer boards by id pattern *inside* `buildTasksForNode` would let Tahajjud's keyword matchers — `/witr|siwak|rawatib|light du/` — pull **other prayers'** tasks into its windows. **Inference both misses and bleeds here; the board is ground truth.**
- **A covenant defect caught inside the fix, before it shipped.** `levelFromProjectId` derives 1/2/3 from a `_core`/`_growth`/`_excellence` suffix and **defaults to 3** for everything else. Prayer boards match none, so every newly-surfaced prayer task would have worn an **"L3 · Tahsiniyyat"** chip — labelling Fajr's *muʾakkadah* rawātib an **embellishment**. Set `_level: null` and made the chip conditional in `PPTaskCard` instead. A board keyed by *window* carries no Maqasid level, so the honest rendering is **no chip, not a guessed one**; non-prayer nodes still show theirs, which was the regression check.
- **Defect 2 — Tahajjud's Before was showing the prayer itself as its own "before."** `PRAYER_GUIDE.tahajjud.structure` has **no `Sunnah before` row** — only `Qiyām` and `Recommended` — so yesterday's selector mapped `before` → the `Qiyām` row and rendered *the night prayer* as what precedes the night prayer. Correct data, wrong slot: the row answers *what you pray*, the tab asks *what comes first*. The genuine content was **unused in the same object**: two `keys[]` entries — the last-third-of-the-night descent hadith (Bukhārī) and *"Begin with 2 light rakʿahs, then lengthen."* Three options were put to the operator; they chose **"keep it, reframed."** A `SUNNAH_LEAD` table keyed `'{prayerId}:{phase}'` now returns those as `leadNotes[]` with a `rowsCaption` of **"What you rise toward"**, rendered above the row. Nothing is removed — **the ordering does the teaching.** Needles kept all-ASCII for the identical cp1252 silent-miss reason as `SUNNAH_FALLBACK_MATCH`. The no-fiqh constraint held: both notes are existing graded strings verbatim, and the only new prose in the whole change is that four-word caption, which describes a layout rather than making a claim.
- **Verified:** `npm test` **77/77**; ESLint **0 errors** (1 pre-existing `IslamicPanel.jsx` warning); `lint:grounding-strict` and `audit:inline-refs` both held at **0**; `npm run build` `✓ built in 1.49s`. `generate:pillar-glyphs:check` still exits 1 on the same pre-existing Vite SSR cold-start timeout in the *Family* pillar — so `lint:eslint` and `audit:inline-refs` were run separately, to show green the gates that actually cover this change rather than hiding behind a red aggregate.
- **The screenshot tool did not work this session** — *"Screenshot timed out after 5s: the Browser pane is not displayed, so the page is not compositing frames"*, twice. Said plainly in the commit message and to the operator rather than papered over; verification was by **live DOM reads** instead (Tahajjud's Before renders lead notes → `WHAT YOU RISE TOWARD` → the `Qiyām` row → the waking-protocol task; the other five prayers each surface their window's seeded tasks; a non-prayer node still renders both the generic threshold and the level chip). **This corrects the conclusion filed one day earlier** in the entry below, that the hang was intermittent and had been resolved: it is intermittent **and pane-visibility-dependent**, which is the sharper reading for the still-unwritten [[project-screenshot-hang]].
- **A false negative caught and corrected mid-verification, not reported as a finding.** `/Dhuhr/i.test(node.textContent)` matched node 11 — *"Qaylulah — Midday Rest — A short pre-**Dhuhr** nap"*, a non-prayer node — producing an apparent "empty Dhuhr". Enumerating all 16 node labels and opening index 12 (*"Dhuhr Prayers"*) directly gave the correct result: 4 rakʿahs + 2 tasks before, 2 rakʿahs + 2 tasks after. **A regex over rendered node text is not a node selector.**
- **Decisions:** [[2026-07-23-milos-prayer-phase-task-boards]] (new). [[2026-07-23-milos-prayer-node-sunnah-tabs]] amended in place — its Tahajjud table row and selector-shape section both described the `before → Qiyām row` behaviour this change corrects, and its screenshot-reliability conclusion is now marked as too strong.
- **Debt recorded.** (a) **`PRAYER_BOARDS` still ships `moduleId: null` at source** — the popup routes around it, but any *other* surface going through `buildTasksForNode` still cannot see prayer boards. Deliberately not fixed here; it needs the migration and scoping decision named above. (b) `SUNNAH_LEAD` is a **per-window escape hatch**, not a general mechanism — entries for prayers that already have a `Sunnah before` row would duplicate content rather than order it. (c) The `prayer_{id}_{phase}` id format is now contract in a second place; changing `PRAYER_LEVELS`' `key` values would silently empty these tabs.
- **Deferred:** pushing (not requested). Still outstanding from prior sessions and untouched: the `--text1` sweep across 5 CSS files, the `isPrayerLocked` → `prayerBannerActive` rename, the duplicated 2026-07-09 log entry, `SCHEMA.md`'s "append to log" wording (this file is **prepended** newest-first), and the missing [[project-screenshot-hang]] page.
- **Contradiction check.** One found and repaired rather than left to rot: the screenshot-reliability claim in the entry below, corrected in place with a `[!warning]` callout. `src/components/islamic/CONTEXT.md` was updated **in the same commit** as the code — the direct-board read, the `_level: null` rule and the Tahajjud lead-in each got a paragraph — applying the [[2026-07-09-milos-prayer-banner-non-blocking]] lesson that under the Context-First Protocol a stale CONTEXT.md is a live defect, not a documentation nit.

## [2026-07-23] session | MILOS — Prophetic Path node popup (Before/During/After), then each prayer's own Sunnah on the six prayer nodes

Two linked changes on the Prophetic Path spine. The first replaced the per-node satellite buttons with a single Before/During/After popup and removed the inline spine mirror; the second fixed the defect the first exposed — all six prayer nodes showing the same threshold.

**Amanah gate:** neutral as code, positive as covenant. No capital instrument, no CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share surface anywhere in the diff. The prayer change **authored no fiqh** — every rakʿah count, tier, note and citation already existed, already hadith-graded, in `PRAYER_GUIDE`. That constraint was chosen deliberately: a component composing its own Sunnah text would be a covenant liability however correct it looked, and staying inside the existing graded data is what kept both grounding ratchets at 0 with no NotebookLM pass required.

- **Completed — part 1, the node popup** ([[2026-07-22-milos-prophetic-path-node-popup]]): the `.pp-satellite` Before/After buttons were the only route to a node's opening/closing threshold, and `PropheticPath.css` **hid them on every node that was not currently active**. So across almost the whole timeline — everything past, everything upcoming — the thresholds were unreachable; the one node you could open a ceremony from was the one you were already standing in. Clicking any node card now opens `NodePhaseSlideUp` (portal → `document.body`), a slide-up with a three-tab pill switch defaulting to **During**: Before → threshold preview + that phase's tasks; During → `MirrorCard`, or on prayer nodes a hand-off into `PrayerSlideUp`; After → closing preview + tasks. The **inline spine mirror was removed** — operator chose "Option A, clean timeline" from a rendered side-by-side, so the spine reads as a day and marks the current node only as *now*. The ceremony is not rendered locally: "Begin opening/closing" sets `openingModuleId`/`closingModuleId` on threshold-store and closes the popup, handing off to the globally-mounted `ThresholdModal`. Extractions: `PropheticPathMirror.jsx` (`MirrorCard`/`PPTaskCard`/`EducationList`/`ProjectRow`) and `prophetic-path-constants.js` — which imports from *neither* consumer, and that is what breaks the circular import — plus `resolveCeremonyData(moduleId, valuesLayer)` newly exported from `islamic-data.js` so a threshold *preview* resolves the same pillar fallback the ceremony applies (`MODULE_ATTRS` is pillar-keyed; `faith-salah` alone resolves to `null`). `PropheticPath.jsx` −437 lines, `PropheticPath.css` −51.
- **Completed — part 2, per-prayer Sunnah** ([[2026-07-23-milos-prayer-node-sunnah-tabs]]): the operator opened the new popup on the prayer nodes and returned a fiqh correction, not a UI one — *"Each prayer has a unique Sunnah before and after. Identify and present before updating."* Root cause: `THRESHOLD_MODULE_BY_NODE` maps all six prayer nodes to `faith-salah`, so `<CeremonySummary moduleId="faith-salah">` rendered one du'a twelve times (6 nodes × Before/After). The fix surfaces `PRAYER_GUIDE` through a new exported selector `getPrayerPhaseSunnah(prayerId, phase)` (the guide itself stays private) and a new `PrayerSunnahSummary.jsx` with co-located CSS. Content now per prayer: Fajr 2 before (Muslim 725) / none after; Dhuhr 4 + 2 (Muslim 728a); ʿAṣr 4 before, T2 (Tirmidhi 430) / none after; Maghrib none fixed before / 2 after with al-Kāfirūn + al-Ikhlāṣ (Ibn Majah 1166); Isha 4 optional before (Bukhari 627) / 2 + Witr after (Muslim 752, Abu Dawud 1422); Tahajjud Qiyām in pairs of 2 (Bukhari 990, Muslim 767b) / Witr seals the night.
- **Three design points worth carrying forward.** (1) The selector returns `rows[]`, an **array** rather than the flat object the plan specified — forced by Isha, whose "after" legitimately carries *two* distinct prayers (the 2-rakʿah rawātib **and** Witr); flattening them would have merged two separate prophetic acts into one card. (2) The four windows with **no** rawātib are surfaced **honestly** as prohibition/permission notes drawn from `keys[]`, never padded with a count — Fajr and ʿAṣr "after" are *prohibitions*, Maghrib "before" a permission, Tahajjud "after" the no-two-witrs rule. A UI that fills every slot symmetrically would be teaching a prayer that should not be prayed. (3) Every fallback needle is deliberately **all-ASCII** — `startsWith('Qiy')`, not `'Qiyām'` — because on a Windows/cp1252 checkout a diacritic needle is a silent miss that blanks a real card with no error anywhere.
- **Portal constraint, restated because it fails silently:** every rule in `PropheticPath.css` is scoped under `.prophetic-path`, but the popup portals into `<body>`. The portal root therefore carries `className="prophetic-path pp-phase-slideup"` + `data-theme`, and `.pp-phase-slideup.prophetic-path { display: contents }` strips the root's own 100vh flex box while custom properties still inherit. Drop either half and the mirror/pill-switch styling disappears with **no error**. Corollary now binding on future work: component CSS for popup *content* must be **unscoped** — `PrayerSunnahSummary.css` follows `CeremonySummary.css`'s precedent and says so in its file header, so the next reader does not "fix" it by scoping it.
- **Verified:** `npm test` **77/77**; `npm run lint` — ESLint + `lint:grounding-strict` + `audit:inline-refs` all green, both ratchets held at **0**; `npm run build` `✓ built in 1.47s`. Preview-verified **with screenshots** per the operator's standing rule: Fajr Before/After, Maghrib Before/After, Isha After showing *both* the rawātib row and the Witr row, `valuesLayer: universal` with the Arabic suppressed, and 375px mobile — plus the load-bearing regression check that a non-prayer node (`midday-labor`) still renders the generic threshold, which is what proves the branch is scoped. Zero console errors; preview left clean (Islamic layer restored, desktop viewport, popup closed).
- **Known failure, disclosed not papered over:** `generate:pillar-glyphs:check` exits 1 with `Error: transport invoke timed out after 60000ms` on `src/pages/family/FamilyLevelNavigator-constants.js` — a Vite SSR cold-start timeout in this environment, in the *Family* pillar, unrelated to this change. It was predicted by name in the approved plan.
- **Screenshot-tool note.** The 2026-07-09 and 2026-07-10 sessions both recorded the screenshot tool timing out at 30 s and produced no visual capture at all. It **worked throughout this session**, desktop and mobile. The hang is therefore intermittent rather than a standing limitation of this project — worth knowing when weighing the `[[project-screenshot-hang]]` class of report (a page which, as the 07-09 lint finding noted, is linked from ~8 decisions but still does not exist).
- **Decisions:** [[2026-07-22-milos-prophetic-path-node-popup]], [[2026-07-23-milos-prayer-node-sunnah-tabs]].
- **Debt recorded.** (a) `PRAYER_GUIDE`'s `kind` strings (`'Sunnah before'`, `'Sunnah after'`, `'Witr'`, `'Qiyām'`) and its `keys[]` prose are now **UI contract**, not just seed input — the selector matches on both, so renaming a `kind` or rewording a prohibition key silently blanks a card. (b) `--text1` is referenced by **5 CSS files but defined nowhere** in `src/styles/tokens.css`; this component uses the real `--text` token, and the five stale references want a sweep. (c) Still outstanding from 2026-07-09: the `isPrayerLocked` → `prayerBannerActive` rename, untouched this session.
- **Deferred:** committing — the whole session's work (5 modified + 8 new files under `src/`) sits **uncommitted** on `feat/desktop-pillar-glyphs`; no commit or push was requested. The `--text1` sweep. The preview localStorage keys (`bbiz_user`, onboarding, `bbiz_values_layer`) were left in place by explicit operator instruction ("keep for now").
- **Contradiction check.** Nothing in this session contradicts existing wiki content. `src/components/islamic/CONTEXT.md` was updated **in the same session** as the code (`CeremonySummary` re-scoped to "non-prayer nodes", `PrayerSunnahSummary` added to the inventory, the popup architecture section rewritten) — deliberately, applying the [[2026-07-09-milos-prayer-banner-non-blocking]] lesson that under the Context-First Protocol a stale CONTEXT.md is a live defect, not a documentation nit. The 2026-04-21 entry recording "Before button decoupled from Threshold modal" describes the satellite-era wiring this session replaced; superseded, not contradicted.
  > [!warning] Duplicate log entry found — not repaired, operator's call
  > **`## [2026-07-09] session | MILOS — prayer overlay finished its de-lock` appears twice in this file**: once at the top (the 2026-07-10 backfill, whose `[!note]` explains that commit `0eb991c` had skipped it) and again near the bottom of the file, in the pre-2026-07 region. The two copies are byte-identical through their `Pages touched` line. The likely cause is that the 07-10 backfill was both prepended *and* appended, or that a later session appended to a file it read as append-only. **Left in place** — deleting ~28 lines of an append-only record is the operator's decision, not mine. It also means the file's ordering convention is worth stating explicitly somewhere: entries are **prepended newest-first** after the frontmatter, which `SCHEMA.md` describes only as "append to log" and is exactly the ambiguity that would produce this duplicate.

## [2026-07-09] session | MILOS — prayer overlay finished its de-lock (slim non-blocking banner)

Operator brief: *"When it is time for prayer, a feature appears that blocks part of the screen that can't be removed until prayer time is over. This needs to be changed so that the user still sees it's prayer time but also is able to continue using the app. Banner wording should be updated as well."* Form factor chosen by the operator from four options (slim top banner); countdown + wording delegated to "best UX option."

**Amanah gate:** neutral — prayer-time UX only, no capital instrument, no CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share surface. The change *strengthens* the covenant posture on two counts: it stops the app making a false claim to its user ("screen will pause"), and it refuses to invite a fard prayer before its time enters.

> [!warning] Contradiction — resolved, and worth keeping
> The 2026-04-22 log entry (§3, *"PrayerOverlay — removed app-wide lockout"*) records the fullscreen `inset:0` scrim + 88% black backdrop + `useFocusTrap` + `aria-modal="true"` being replaced by a `pointer-events:none` card with `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"` and an Alhamdulillah dismiss. **That entry is accurate** — `git show HEAD~1` confirms every claim was still true on 2026-07-09. Yet the operator, using the app, experienced a lock.
>
> Both are true. **2026-04-22 removed the lock's mechanism and left four of its signals standing**, each independently sufficient to reconstruct the impression: the warning copy *promised* a pause in words; dismissal chained into `ResumeOverlay` so the only exit summoned a second overlay; the card was a 320px near-opaque black panel (`pointer-events:none` makes a thing click-through, not invisible); and an `mm:ss` countdown framed it as time to be served. Compounding it, `src/components/islamic/CONTEXT.md` still documented the pre-de-lock behaviour and the store flag is still named `isPrayerLocked` — so every subsequent reader re-learned a lock that was not there. Two explore agents in this session's first pass duly reported PrayerOverlay as a "full-screen blocker," sourcing that CONTEXT.md.
>
> **Lesson for the wiki:** "removed the mechanism" is not "removed the behaviour." A de-lock is not complete while the copy, the exit path, the opacity, and the docs still say *lock*. Under the Context-First Protocol — which mandates trusting `CONTEXT.md` over reading source — a stale CONTEXT.md is not a documentation nit; it is a live defect that propagates into agent reasoning.

- **Completed** (commit `e4302ce`, 5 files, +137/−127, `feat/desktop-pillar-glyphs`, **not pushed**):
  - **`PrayerOverlay.jsx`** — bottom-right opaque card → top-centre pill on the project token set; `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"` retained. Per-second `setInterval` + `mm:ss` countdown **deleted**, replaced by two `setTimeout`s: one flipping the copy at `prayerTimeMs`, one auto-clearing at `prayerTimeMs + PRESENCE_CONFIG.PRAYER_TRAIL_MS`. Dismissible **two** ways — the existing Alhamdulillah acknowledgment and a new close (✕) button.
  - **`PrayerOverlay.css`** — pill geometry mirroring `PrayerWarning` (`--surface` / `--accent-border` / `--radius-full` / `--shadow-lg`); new `@media (max-width:640px)` block (project banner/toast breakpoint) so the banner spans the viewport instead of shrink-wrapping.
  - **`PrayerWarning.jsx`** — the copy "{prayer} in Nm — screen will pause in M minute(s)" becomes "{prayer} approaching · Nm". The `minutesUntilLock` prop **deleted**, not merely unused.
  - **`AppShell.jsx`** — `handlePrayerDismiss` no longer chains into `triggerResume(activeModule)`; it clears the flag and nothing else. Deps trim to `[setPrayerLock]`; the dead `minutesUntilLock` computation removed.
  - **`src/components/islamic/CONTEXT.md`** — prayer-system section rewritten; it described the pre-2026-04-22 blocking behaviour and a 1-second countdown that no longer exists.
- **Load-bearing detail — the message flip is theological, not cosmetic.** The banner mounts `PRAYER_LEAD_MS` (5 min) **before** the adhan, so it reads *"It's almost time for {prayer}"* until `prayerTimeMs` and only then *"It's time for {prayer} — pray when you're able."* Declaring "it's time" during the lead window would invite praying a fard before its time enters, which does not discharge the obligation. This survived a fight with the flat config's `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` (an **error**, not a warning): the naïve fix is to delete the distinction. Correct resolution — initial value from the `useState` initializer, flip inside the `setTimeout` callback (which the rule permits), and **no in-place reset**, since `AppShell` mounts a fresh overlay per prayer so `prayerTimeMs` is stable per instance.
- **Verified:** `npm run lint:eslint` 0 errors (1 pre-existing unrelated `IslamicPanel.jsx` warning); `npm run build` green. Non-blocking **proven, not assumed** — `document.elementFromPoint` over the workspace returned app content, and a live sidebar click changed the route with the banner still mounted. Copy flip proven by a genuine remount (`setPrayerLock(false)` then `setPrayerLock(true, …, futureMs)` in separate evals), necessary precisely because the in-place reset was removed. Grounding gate + `npm test` **not** re-run — no seed-task / `sources[]` edit, which is what those ratchets guard. A mobile defect was found *during* verification (375px shrink-wrap to a 188×143px tall column) and fixed beyond the literal plan with the 640px block (→ 351×77px); disclosed to the operator as a scope addition at the time.
- **`preview_screenshot` timed out 6× at 30s** — Landing, `/app/pillar/wealth`, animations frozen, 66 SVG/wheel nodes hidden, after resize, and with the entire app hidden leaving only the banner on a solid background. `eval` / `inspect` / `click` / `resize` all answered instantly, console clean ⇒ the rasterizer is at fault, not the page. **No visual capture exists for this change.** Reported rather than papered over, per the operator's standing rule. [[project-screenshot-hang]]-class.

- **Debt recorded:** `isPrayerLocked` / `setPrayerLock` (`threshold-store.js`) is now a **misnomer** — it gates a banner, not a lock, and has done since 2026-04-22. It is the last surviving artifact of the lock era and the likeliest source of the next false "MILOS locks the screen during prayer" reading. Rename to `prayerBannerActive` / `setPrayerBanner` when a session next touches that store. Also: the universal (`valuesLayer !== 'islamic'`) branch of `PrayerOverlay` is unreachable dead code — `valuesLayer` defaults to `'islamic'` with no UI to change it.

## [2026-07-09] session | MILOS — Verse banner inset past right chrome + equal-height rounded Niyyah buttons (PTE work superseded by main)

**Objective:** Ship two operator-requested app-shell UI fixes — equal-height rounded NiyyahAct footer buttons, and stop the TopBar verse banner overlapping the right rail — then push and open a PR into `main`.

**Amanah gate:** neutral — presentational shell CSS + one layout inline-style; no capital / sale / CSA / CSRA / salam / yield-share surface.

- **Niyyah buttons** ([NiyyahAct.css](src/components/islamic/NiyyahAct.css)): `.niyyah-footer` `align-items: center`→`stretch` (equal height); `.niyyah-skip` gains `display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;` (re-center label once stretched); both `.niyyah-confirm`/`.niyyah-skip` `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`→`var(--radius)`. **Gotcha:** `--radius-md` is undefined repo-wide (0 definitions in `src/`) → invalid declaration → `border-radius` fell back to initial `0` (square); `--radius` (10px) is the real token. That swap is what produces the "rounded corners."
- **Verse banner** ([TopBar.jsx](src/components/layout/TopBar.jsx)): inline `right` changed from `islamicPanelOpen && !mobile ? \`${islamicPanelWidthPx + 28}px\` : 0` to `mobile ? 0 : \`${28 + (islamicPanelOpen ? islamicPanelWidthPx : 64)}px\``. The banner is `position:absolute; left:var(--edge-w); right:0` inside the `grid-column:2/-1` topbar; when the panel was closed the old `right:0` ran it to the viewport edge over the 28px right-edge column + 64px rail. New value always insets past the right chrome (28px edge + panel-or-64px-rail), mirroring the left `var(--edge-w)` inset; mobile keeps `right:0` (no right column).
- **Reconciliation (the notable event):** this branch also had a PTE-CTA wiring commit + draft ADR — both **superseded**. `origin/main` independently landed **functionally-identical** wiring for all 7 siblings **plus** Faith via **PR #20** ([[2026-07-03-milos-pte-cta-wiring]]); `git diff` vs `origin/main` confirmed identical `route:` literals + `onClick` (whitespace-only delta). Dropped the duplicate commit + draft ADR; **rebuilt the branch on current `origin/main`** carrying only the two net-new UI fixes.
- **Verified:** in the implementing session (2026-07-04) both fixes live-verified — Niyyah buttons computed equal **42px height + 10px radius**; verse banner right edge aligned to the main column, **no overlap** — each by computed-style **and** `preview_screenshot` (channel responsive that session). On the rebuilt branch: `npm run lint` green (ratchets 0), `npm test` **77/77**, `npm run build` green.

## [2026-07-05] session | MILOS — Desktop dashboard pillar strip gets grouped icon+label glyphs (Option B)

**Objective:** Extend the mobile pillar glyphs to the desktop (≥768px) `LevelNavigator` strip, with the glyph grouped with the label as one identity block below the bar (**Option B**, user-chosen).

**Amanah gate:** neutral — presentational nav-chrome CSS; no capital / sale / CSA / CSRA / salam / yield-share surface.

- **Change:** Added a new, **disjoint** `@media (min-width:768px)` block to the MILOS-owned override [src/styles/level-navigator-responsive.css](src/styles/level-navigator-responsive.css) (never a fork of `@ogden/ui-components`). Keyed on the seven dashboard `data-pillar-id`s, it (1) sets each `.fln__segment-nav` label button to a centered block (`display:block; text-align:center; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis`) and (2) adds a grouped glyph on `.fln__segment-nav::before` (18px box, `margin:0 auto 4px`, `background:var(--seg-color)`, `mask-size:100% 100%`) with seven per-pillar `mask-image` data-URIs **reused verbatim from the mobile block** (Compass · HeartPulse · Brain · Users · ChessRook · TreePine · Shapes, lucide-react v1.8.0). Both anchored on the proven doubled-class `.fln__segments.fln__segments …` specificity anchor (0,5,0 / `::before` 0,5,1). Closes the "desktop is labels-only — Deferred" note from [[2026-07-04-milos-dashboard-pillar-icons]].
- **Load-bearing discovery:** `white-space:nowrap`+`text-overflow:ellipsis` is the load-bearing choice, **not** wrapping. The desktop `.fln__segments` is content-sized; its `flex:2.8 1 0%` grandparent `.fln__center` (basis 0) is pushed only as wide as the labels' min-content. Keeping every label unbreakable holds min-content high → the strip renders full (~560px) with the three longest names ellipsizing. Any wrap/break rule (`overflow-wrap:anywhere`, or `align-items:stretch`+`break-word`) collapses `.fln__center` to its ~318px flex-grow share and the strip caves to a ~252px sliver with labels shredded character-by-character. Found empirically — two failed attempts before nowrap+ellipsis.
- **Verified:** `npm run build` green (1.30s; only the pre-existing `auth-store INEFFECTIVE_DYNAMIC_IMPORT` warning), `npm run lint` 0 (grounding-strict + inline-refs ratchets 0), `npm test` 77/77. At 1280×900: strip width **560px stable**; all 7 `.fln__segment-nav` compute `display:block`+`white-space:nowrap`; all 7 `::before` compute `content:""`, `display:block`, `margin:0 auto 4px`, `mask-image` present, fill = `--seg-color`; only Intellect/Environment/Community ellipsize; nav `clientHeight===scrollHeight` (glyph+label fit). Canvas-rasterizing each mask URI → **7 distinct, non-blank glyphs**. A `preview_screenshot` **succeeded** this session (the heavy dashboard usually hits the 30s [[project-screenshot-hang]]). Mobile 375px re-check: desktop rule off, mobile glyph on — **zero regression**.
- **Decisions filed:** [[2026-07-05-milos-desktop-pillar-glyphs]] (accepted).
- **Deferred:** true multi-line label wrapping (needs a fixed strip width — package-layout surgery, not an override change); consolidating the mobile+desktop URI sets behind a committed generator; extending glyphs to sub-pillar / prayer / BBOS strips.
- **Delivery:** CSS + ADR + `milos.md`/`index.md`/`log.md` rows shipped on `feat/levelnav-desktop-glyphs` off `main`, PR into `main`. Best merged **after** PR #22 (the wiki-only docs branch adding [[2026-07-04-milos-dashboard-pillar-icons]]) so this ADR's cross-link resolves.

## [2026-07-02] session | MILOS — App.jsx route pages converted to React.lazy code-splitting

**Objective:** Started as "load mobile preview"; the preview came up blank/slow, and the root cause — `src/App.jsx` eagerly importing ~60 route page modules (100+ modules compiled before first paint on Vite dev) — was scoped, planned, approved, and fixed. Convert the eager page imports to `React.lazy` to shrink the cold-load / entry chunk.

**Amanah gate:** neutral — build/performance + client-side routing; no capital / sale / CSA / CSRA / salam / yield-share surface.

- **Change (approved plan, executed phase-by-phase):** ~55 route page imports in [src/App.jsx](src/App.jsx) → `lazy(() => import(...))` under the **pre-existing** top-level `<ChunkErrorBoundary><Suspense fallback={<RouteSpinner/>}>` (from [[2026-04-25-milos-tier-2-polish]]). **Only `Landing` + `AppShell` stay eager** — Landing so `/` never flashes a spinner, AppShell as the `/app/*` shell. **5 dead dashboard imports** (`FaithDashboard`/`HealthDashboard`/`IntellectDashboard`/`FamilyDashboard`/`EnvironmentDashboard` — imported, never rendered; ESLint missed them because the flat config's `no-unused-vars` `varsIgnorePattern:'^[A-Z_]'` exempts PascalCase) **deleted** rather than converted to dead lazy consts (grep-confirmed no JSX usage).
- **Preview plumbing carried in the same working tree** (from the prior blank-preview session): [vite.config.js](vite.config.js) `server.port = process.env.PORT ? Number(process.env.PORT) : 5173` + `import process from 'node:process'` (the flat ESLint config loads `globals.browser` only — a bare `process` is `no-undef`); [.claude/launch.json](.claude/launch.json) `"MAQASID OS - Dev"` `autoPort:true`.
- **Measured effect (fresh `vite build`, reproduced this session):** entry JS `1,747.69 → 1,536.45 kB` (gzip `471.56 → 438.17`, **−211 kB / −12%**); entry CSS `400.10 → 268.24 kB` (gzip `57.52 → 42.56`, **−132 kB / −33%**); ~55 per-route JS+CSS chunks now emitted, loaded only when the route is visited. **Why `manualChunks` alone couldn't do this:** a static `import` keeps the page in the entry graph regardless of chunk assignment — only `import()` peels it off. This is the **page-level sibling** of the data-level [[2026-04-25-milos-chunk-split]] (`seed-hydrator` `PILLAR_LOADERS`).
- **Verified:** `npm run lint` 0 errors (grounding-strict + inline-refs ratchets both 0); `npm test` 77/77 (3 files); mobile preview (375×812) — Landing renders identically (eager), and lazy Dashboard (`/app`) + lazy Faith pillar (`/app/pillar/faith` → `FaithCorePage`) both resolve to real content ("Begin today with intention…" / "SHAHADA SALAH ZAKAH SIYAM HAJJ … Path to Excellence") with **no ChunkLoadError, no error boundary, no console errors**. Verified by `preview_eval` DOM + a11y polling; **`preview_screenshot` timed out at 30s** on this heavy page (a known [[project-screenshot-hang]]-class recurrence) — disclosed, not assumed.
- **Decisions filed:** [[2026-07-02-milos-route-lazy-splitting]].
- **Deferred (Deferred Ideas — none implemented, per the no-undiscussed-change rule):** **(1, top next step)** `AppShell` is still eager, so its entire dependency tree (Sidebar, TopBar, MobileNav, IslamicRail + IslamicPanel, prayer-posture images, seed-hydrator, stores) loads on **every** route incl. Landing `/` — the dominant remaining cold-load cost the page-level split does not touch; fix = lazy `AppShell` **and** move `<Suspense>` inside its `<Outlet>` (avoids a shell-chrome flash). **(2)** `ProjectBoard` (~387 kB), `AssetsTab`, `ProjectJournal` remain eager in App.jsx though only nested `work/*` routes use them. **(3)** Pre-existing, not from this change: the `IslamicPanel.jsx` unused-`eslint-disable` warning; the `INEFFECTIVE_DYNAMIC_IMPORT` build warning for `auth-store`.
- **Delivery:** **uncommitted** working-tree change on `feat/right-sidebar-symmetry` (`src/App.jsx`, `vite.config.js`, `.claude/launch.json`) — **not committed**, operator-gated. Recommended per the standing branch strategy: code on a fresh `perf/route-lazy-splitting` cut from `main`, wiki on the current branch.

## [2026-07-01] session | MILOS — LevelNavigator pillar segments made mobile-friendly

**Objective:** Make the `LevelNavigator` pillar segment strip (FAITH / HEALTH / INTELLECT / FAMILY / WEALTH / ENVIRONMENT / COMMUNITY under "Core Higher Objectives") usable on phones. User selected `.fln__segments` in the preview and asked for the best-UX mobile treatment, ideas before implementation.

**Amanah gate:** neutral — responsive CSS presentation of an existing pillar navigation surface; no capital / sale / CSA / CSRA / salam / yield-share surface.

- **Diagnosis (measured live at 375px on `/app`):** 7 pillar columns crammed into ~239px → **27px/column**; each task subseg a **1px × 14px tap target** (vs ~44px WCAG min); every label truncated to a single ambiguous letter ("F…" for *both* Faith and Family). The package's own `@media (max-width:700px)` only rearranges the outer level panels, never the inner segment row — that was the gap.
- **Chosen approach (via AskUserQuestion):** vertical stacked rows, initially applied to the level-overview surfaces (dashboard + 7 pillar pages); in the same session (follow-up **"a and b"**) the scope was **broadened app-wide** to every LevelNavigator strip — incl. the pillar-submodule pages ([PillarLevelPage](src/pages/shared/PillarLevelPage.jsx)), the prayer page ([PrayerLevelPage](src/pages/shared/PrayerLevelPage.jsx) via `PrayerLevelNavigator`), and the legacy BBOS pipeline-stage nav ([ProjectBoard](src/components/work/ProjectBoard.jsx)).
- **Fix (CSS-only, no fork/JSX change):** `LevelNavigator` is external (`@ogden/ui-components`, `github:onaxyzogden/ogden-ui-components#v0.1.0`), so the fix is a MILOS-owned **global** stylesheet [src/styles/level-navigator-responsive.css](src/styles/level-navigator-responsive.css), imported once at [src/main.jsx](src/main.jsx) **after** the package CSS. It anchors on a **doubled class** `.fln__segments.fln__segments` (specificity 0,2,0; descendants 0,3,0) so it beats the package's 0,1,0 base regardless of order and reaches every instance — including those that render the package directly and bypass the shared `LevelNavigator.jsx` wrapper. At ≤767px `.fln__segments` → `flex-direction:column`; each `.fln__segment-col` → horizontal `[label | bar]` row; `.fln__segment-nav` fixed 92px legible label; `.fln__segment-bar` → 44px tall so subsegs inherit tappable height + take `rowWidth/N` width. `@media (max-width:479px)` trims the label column to 76px. Dominant **767px** breakpoint (37 uses, matches `useMobile`); `taskColorFn` subseg colors + `.fln__segment-col--current` tint untouched. The interim `.flo`-scoped block in `LevelOverviewPage.css` was **removed as redundant** (single source of truth).
- **Verified (live preview):** at 375px on `/app` — `.fln__segments` `flex-direction:column`, bar 44px, subsegs 1px×14px → ~23px×44px, all 7 labels de-truncated; at 994px desktop unchanged (`flex-direction:row`). Confirmed by computed-style inspection (`preview_eval`) **and** a screenshot of the stacked strip; with the `.flo` block removed, this dashboard proof exercises the global rule directly. Pillar-submodule / prayer / BBOS strips render the identical `.fln__segments` DOM under the same route-agnostic rule but sit behind an unrelated multi-step ceremony gate / project state — confirmed by mechanism + code parity, not individually screen-captured (disclosed).
- **Decisions filed:** [[2026-07-01-milos-levelnavigator-mobile-stacked-rows]] (rewritten for the global approach).
- **Commits (per user's branch strategy):** code on a new `fix/levelnavigator-mobile-stacked-rows` branch cut from `main` (clean PR base); wiki docs on the current `feat/right-sidebar-symmetry` branch (where the pending wiki history lives). `atlas` submodule / worktree / the 2026-06-26 OLOS ADR excluded from both.
- **Deferred:** none. Values (row heights / label widths) are tuned but could be revisited if design feedback warrants.
- **Pages touched:** [[milos]] (frontmatter date + History row), [[2026-07-01-milos-levelnavigator-mobile-stacked-rows]] (ADR), [[index]] (Decisions row + `updated`), `log.md` (this entry). Code: [src/styles/level-navigator-responsive.css](src/styles/level-navigator-responsive.css) (new), [src/main.jsx](src/main.jsx) (import), [src/pages/shared/LevelOverviewPage.css](src/pages/shared/LevelOverviewPage.css) (`.flo` block removed).

Deferred on that one assertion + tracked as a background fix-task (move the link outside the listbox), rather than restructuring a shipped popover blind. ## [2026-06-24] fix | OLOS — PR #51 CI-fix + lossless main-merge (Operational Role Layer made mergeable)

**Objective:** A CI-monitor event reported PR [#51](https://github.com/onaxyzogden/atlas/pull/51) (`fix/operational-role-layer` → `main`, the [[olos]] Operational Role Layer) with its `test` check FAILING and merge conflicts. Make the PR green and mergeable without dropping any of `main`'s work.

**Amanah gate:** neutral — CI/test hygiene + a git merge; no capital/sale/CSA surface touched.

- **Two `test` failures fixed (`b47ddcc6`):** (1) `apps/web` `uiStore` v4 `migrate` seeded an empty `viewFocusMode` for pre-v4 payloads, breaking `migrateUIPersistedState`'s idempotent same-reference contract pinned by `uiStoreMigrate.test.ts` — the key is already supplied by the store's initial state via zustand's shallow persist-merge, so the seed was redundant; dropped the `fromVersion<4` block (kept `version:4` as a forward-only shape stamp) and replaced two contradicting unit tests with one idempotent pass-through test. (2) The `syncManifest` coverage guard flagged the unclassified persisted store `ogden-atlas-zone-ring-config` (`zoneRingConfigStore`) — parked in `DEVICE_GLOBAL` per the `ogden-community-meeting-place` precedent (project-design data, client-first, no server transport yet; promote-to-`SYNCED_STORES`-when-wired note).
- **Merge conflict resolved losslessly:** `main` had advanced to `ac052f42` (Demo #50, which folded a later `fix/web-ci-baseline` via `b5bc8f3f`). A pre-compaction `git merge origin/main` was in progress; the fix commit consumed it, so `b47ddcc6` is a **2-parent merge** (parents `bb1dc3f8` + `ac052f42`). The two real conflict files (`ActTierStratumSwitcher.tsx`, `PlanTierShell.tsx` — the shared rail-header / tier-shell work) resolved to **ours**, PROVEN lossless: `git diff --numstat ac052f42 bb1dc3f8` = `31 0` / `64 0` (zero deletions ⇒ ours is a strict textual superset of main's version; the conflict existed only against the stale base `e1bf84b6` because both branches carry the same `fix/web-ci-baseline` rail work). `merge-tree(bb1dc3f8,ac052f42) → b47ddcc6` deviates in exactly the 5 expected files (3 fixes + 2 conflict files with only conflict-marker lines removed).
- **Verified:** `tsc` clean; full `apps/web` vitest **614 files / 6513 tests green** locally (the FULL suite, not a bounded subset). Pushed `bb1dc3f8..b47ddcc6` (fast-forward). Remote CI all green — `test`×4 matrix, `typecheck`, `build`, `integration`, `lint`; PR now `mergeable:MERGEABLE` / `mergeStateStatus:CLEAN`. Foreign WIP (stash `preserve-foreign-wip-during-merge-pr51`: 4 tracked + 3 untracked files) restored to the working tree afterward (clean pop, no merge overlap), left UNSTAGED; no foreign files committed.
- **Lesson:** run the FULL suite (a bounded subset is how the two regressions slipped) and inspect the commit graph (`git cat-file -p HEAD`) when ancestry diagnostics look paradoxical — a fix commit can silently absorb an in-flight merge.
- **Decisions filed:** none new — ADR [[2026-06-24-atlas-spec-operational-role-layer]] already covers the feature.

## [2026-06-24] feat | OLOS — Operational Role Layer (per-member domain-scoped default view across Plan/Act/Observe)

**Objective:** A second, orthogonal role axis. The pre-existing **system role** (`ProjectRole`) governs which *surfaces* a user reaches; the new **operational role** (`project_members.operational_roles[]`) governs which *domains* are a member's **default focus** within them. Six built-in roles, stored per-membership (differ per project), that **stack** (union of domain scopes); suppressed on solo projects; never applies to contractors/landowners/reviewers. **Golden rule: never hide, only de-emphasize** — every out-of-scope item stays reachable (dimmed/collapsed) and an always-surface engine promotes critical ones (open review flag / cross-role dependency / shared-resource divergence) back into focus. **Scope axis = the 16 `UniversalDomain`s** (ecology_soils→{land-base,climate,topography,hydrology,soil,ecology,monitoring-records}; food_production→{plants-food}; livestock→{animals-livestock}; infrastructure→{built-infrastructure,access-circulation,energy-resources,hydrology}; community_governance→{people-governance}; finance_legal→{economics-capacity,risk-compliance}; `hydrology` the sole shared domain; `vision-intent` primary-steward-only). Empty roles ⇒ full view; reuses the pre-existing `getObjectiveObserveDomains` resolver (no catalogue re-authoring).

**Amanah gate:** clean — view-scoping is halal coordination; `finance_legal` scopes *which* objectives show, touches no instrument (no CSA/CSRA/salam/yield-share).

- **Completed — six phases, 15 stage-scoped commits (`ad30693a..bb1dc3f8`):** P1 shared taxonomy + helpers (`scopeForRoles`/`isSoloProject`/`operationalRolesApplyTo`/`roleForDomain`/`resolveOperationalRoles` seam) + schema (`ad30693a`); P2 migration 055 (array-containment CHECK) + members route + `PATCH .../operational-roles` (owner writes `projects.metadata`) + apiClient + memberStore selectors + demo seed (`409d1482`); P3 non-gating `s1-steward-c9` capture + `MyOperationalRoleCard` + solo gate + `ScopePreview` + Team Registry chips (`e6d5d9f5`/`31c33889`/`6d131b0f`/`033b89e0`); P4 Act — shared `apps/web/src/v3/roles/` module (viewScope/alwaysSurface/useViewScope/ViewFocusToggle/railScope) + uiStore `viewFocusMode` + rail partition + card scopeState/surfaceChip/roleBadges + map-pin dimming (`86ffb8b5`/`ca14b796`/`62042fc4`/`68acb3a9`/`22b862eb`); P5 Observe — ring in-focus lenses on the live `ObserveLensDashboard` + `ObserveModuleBar` "+N more" collapse + `monitoring-records` custodian note (`359b2ee4`); P6 Plan — live `PlanTierShell` drives the shared rail + per-stratum "N/M in focus" badge on `ActTierStratumSwitcher` (`2981a1f6`), legacy `stratum-spine` `ObjectiveCard`/`ObjectiveColumn` dim in place without reordering strata (`56fde2f4`).
- **Verification-pass remediation (`bb1dc3f8`):** the always-surface engine's shared-resource-divergence channel was DEAD — `collectAlwaysSurface` accepted a `divergedDomains` input but no shell passed it (and `PlanTierShell` carried a comment falsely claiming it worked). ## [2026-06-03] refactor | OLOS — Demote ApiReachabilityBanner to a non-blocking header status chip

**Objective:** Stop the API-reachability warning from blocking important features. Steward's words: "make this a status type in header rather than a banner because it is blocking important features."

**Steward-locked decisions (AskUserQuestion):** (1) **Recovery stays global** — split the component into a headless watcher (keeps the `online` listener + 15s poll running on every route) + a header chip + a shared recovery module, rather than moving effects into a header-only chip. (2) **Chip form = icon + short label + Retry** — `CloudOff` + "Server unreachable" + an explicit Retry button; the full message lives in the `title` attribute.

**Amanah gate:** clear (connectivity/status UI, no fiqh surface).

**What changed (16 files — a 3-piece refactor of one component):**
- `apps/web/src/lib/apiRecovery.ts` (new) — shared `attemptApiRecovery()` with a **module-level `inFlight` guard** (replaces the per-component `inFlightRef`) so the watcher and the chip's Retry share one in-flight lock. Recovery logic lifted verbatim: read auth token → `initFromStorage()` if present, else `api.health()` then `setApiReachable(true)` (swallow failure).
- `apps/web/src/components/ApiReachabilityWatcher.tsx` (new) — headless, renders `null`, owns the two recovery effects (window `online` listener + visibility-aware 15s poll with `visibilitychange` immediate re-check + teardown), mounted globally in `main.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/components/ApiReachabilityStatus.tsx` + `.module.css` (new) — pure presentation chip + Retry (local `retrying` state), mounted in the AppShell header right-cluster after `<ProofSyncIndicator />`, mirroring its `.syncIndicator` pill with the error palette (`rgba(217,119,87,.18)` / `#d97757` / `rgba(217,119,87,.4)`).
- Deleted `ApiReachabilityBanner.tsx` + `.module.css` (global status component, not a legacy *stage* component — no-deletion-in-revamps does not apply). Split its 14-test suite into `ApiReachabilityStatus.test.tsx` (7: render/priority/Retry) + `ApiReachabilityWatcher.test.tsx` (9: online listener + poll), preserving coverage.
- Doc-comment name updates (prose only) in `bootAuthed.ts`, `connectivityStore.ts`, `authStore.ts` + their two test files.

**Accepted consequence:** the visible chip is **header-only** — routes with no header (legacy `/project/`, `/login`, `/showcase/*`) show no on-screen warning, but global recovery still runs via the watcher, so the chip reappears the moment a header route mounts.

(3) **Clone direction** — the CURRENT project switches type **in place** (keeps id/name/map/design entities/URL); the opt-in (default-on) clone is a frozen **backup snapshot under the OLD type** carrying its checklist progress; the steward stays on their own project. (4) **Decline path** — declining the clone still proceeds and discards orphaned progress.

**Amanah gate:** clear (land-stewardship planning UI). One fiqh-relevant surface honoured — the preview surfaces `scopeNotes` Amanah cautions for objectives being **added** (cautions newly taken on — switching INTO Market Garden surfaces the CSA / *bayʿ mā laysa ʿindak* flag verbatim) and **set aside** (cautions left behind), never silently stripped ([[feedback-csa-in-catalogues]]; standing CSRA-erased constraint).

**What changed (10 files, mostly composition of existing primitives):**

- `apps/web/src/store/projectStore.ts` — new `changePrimaryType(projectId, nextPrimaryId, opts?)`. Guards (project + record exist, `nextPrimaryId !== current`, `canBePrimary`); prunes incompatible secondaries via `isCompatibleSecondary`; disappearing objectives via the inverse delta `computeObjectivesDelta(next, current).newObjectiveIds`; appends one `'primary-changed'` entry (actor default `yousef@ogden.ag`); keeps legacy bare `projectType` aligned; retains tension/reopening acks; discards orphaned progress. Returns `{ ok, droppedSecondaryIds, discardedObjectiveIds }` (or `{ ok: false }`).
- `apps/web/src/store/planStratumStore.ts` — `cloneForProject(source, target)` (deep-copies all FOUR per-project slices: `byProject`, `celebratedByProject`, `deferredByProject`, `valuesByProject` — the gap `duplicateProject` leaves, copying design-intent but NOT stratum progress) + `discardObjectivesProgress(project, ids)` (clears the three per-objective slices; leaves the `celebratedByProject` stratum-unlock log untouched).

## [2026-05-31] copy | OLOS — Plan-strata objective titles reworded from imperative tasks to end-state goals (all 12 catalogues)

**Objective:** Reword every Plan-strata objective `title` across all 12 catalogues so each reads as an achieved end-state (a goal) rather than an imperative work instruction (a task), keeping ids/refs/structure untouched, and record the intentional divergence from the verbatim spec wording in an ADR.

**Three locked scope decisions (operator, AskUserQuestion):** (1) scope = **all 12 catalogues** (~199 titles) incl. dormant/unbuilt types, for one consistent voice; (2) voice = **end-state outcome** — phrase each title as the achieved result; (3) provenance = **code + ADR** — reword in code, leave `ref:` pointers untouched, file an ADR recording the divergence.

**What changed:** the `title:` value of every `obj({...})` objective in `packages/shared/src/constants/plan/catalogues/` — `universal.ts` 19, `silvopasture.ts` 31, `residential.ts` 6, `regenFarm.ts` 13, `nursery.ts` 8, `orchard.ts` 30, `agritourism.ts` 29, `ecovillage.ts` 31, `wellness.ts` 32 (= **199**). Voice rules by verb: **Survey/Map/Assess** → "A clear read of …" / "A mapped picture of …"; **Define/Confirm/Decide** → the settled framework with a quality adjective ("Define water strategy" → "A sound, resilient water strategy"); **Design** → the designed system ready to build ("Design access & circulation" → "An efficient access & circulation design"); phasing/register → the completed plan. `PatchRecord` objects carry no `title` and were left untouched; no `id`/`ref`/`source`/`stratumId`/`focusedQuestion`/`checklist`/`decisionGroups`/`completionGate`/`actHandoff`/`parameterGroup` touched. ASCII-only. Ecovillage financial titles reworded ordinary-finance only — **no investor/CSRA/advance-purchase framing** (standing fiqh constraint).

**`ref:` pointers retained as provenance:** display titles now intentionally diverge from the verbatim spec catalogues; the unchanged `ref:` (e.g. `U-S2.1`, `SILV-S4.4`) remains the link back to source.

**`stratumObjectives.ts` is stale dead code** (no live importers, superseded by the catalogues) — left untouched per no-deletion-in-revamps; its titles were NOT reworded. ADR notes it so a future reader treats the catalogues as the live title source.

**Execution:** live vertical slice first (universal + silvopasture + residential, 56 titles), then the 6 dormant catalogues via 6 parallel mechanical-edit subagents fed exact old→new title pairs (no editorial drift) — all 143 dormant edits succeeded (13+8+30+29+31+32).

**Verification:** `packages/shared` `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (no new errors; pre-existing tier-refactor errors are operator WIP, not touched); `catalogues.test.ts` **75/75** green (asserts schema/id/ref/layer invariants, never title text — rewording is test-safe); grep confirms **zero** remaining imperative-verb title prefixes across `catalogues/`.

**Decision:** ADR [[2026-05-31-objective-title-voice]].

**Pages touched:** wiki/decisions/2026-05-31-objective-title-voice.md (new), wiki/index.md, wiki/log.md.
